resources.string: Change input schemes with files such as xxx.custom.yaml, the same way as Rime on a computer. Edit them in “Songyan Rime configuration” in the Files app. Changes take effect after you tap “Apply changes”.

plurals.name: rime_config_in_use
plurals.item: The keyboard uses your %1$d configuration file.
The keyboard uses your %1$d configuration files.

resources.string: No app can edit text. Install a text editor, then try again.
%1$s has a newer version. Your version is still in use.
These files are now your own versions. They won\'t change when the input scheme is updated; all other files are updated as usual.
Lowercase letters, digits and underscores only.
Your extension scripts aren\'t in use yet. Tap Apply changes and confirm them to use them.

Extension scripts can read everything you type. Songyan stops scripts from running commands, loading outside programs and going online, but a flaw in the script engine itself could still be abused. Only use scripts from sources you trust.
This file has extension scripts. Extension scripts can read what you type; use them only if you trust where they came from.
Saved. It takes effect after you apply the changes.
Line %1$d isn\'t written correctly, so nothing was saved.
The file isn\'t written correctly, so nothing was saved.
What you changed hasn\'t been saved.
Fine-tune how whole sentences are ranked by editing a file.
Loading the file replaces your current edits. Keeping your edits will replace the file when you save.
